Naksan Park city wall at night
Walk along the lit-up Joseon city wall above Ihwa mural village – a free night view of downtown Seoul, far from the crowds.
Go 30 minutes after sunset. Residents live below – keep your voice down.

Take the free monorail up and walk down. Small cafés at the top have the best view.
